title: Agent Dispatch Notification Event v1
description: One channel-neutral notification intent of the durable outbox (E13-T1, ADR-0019, DUR-016, NTF-003). The identity derives deterministically from the event, optional destination, transition occurrence, sink, and notification-policy revision, so a replayed or rerun transition collapses onto the same record instead of notifying twice. The payload carries only safe identities, states, reason codes, and digests — never document contents, front matter, resolved secrets, or unredacted paths (SEC-011).

source.description: Bounded safe source fields: identities, states, and reason codes of the reportable transition.
